title: Mirabel and the Extraction
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Coral Quintana, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
